text: September 2026: we cleaned the patio ceiling, eaves and front wall of a Currumbin Waters home. Heavy black mould covered the beams and corrugated sheeting, and the render was streaky. After a low-pressure wash, the sheeting was bright and the timber beams were yellow again.
